id: title:VojtechBartos:add change default row to the composer model popup

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a UI configuration option for desktop users to set a default reasoning level, potentially establishing user preferences before session start.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F2.H4 adds a dropdown menu item and its associated callback to the TaskInput component, enabling users to select a default reasoning level. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for desktop users, allowing them to establish preferred defaults rather than relying solely on existing defaults. The implementation is localized to the frontend
review.uncertainty: The complete backend implementation and actual usage benefit are not demonstrated in this chunk; this score relies solely on the visible UI changes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assigned; score requires assessment of broader change group. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a 'Change default' row to the ReasoningLevelSelector dropdown, guarded by an optional callback, and wires it into TaskInput.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows desktop users to configure the default reasoning level for a session, rather than only resetting to an existing default. This could help users establish preferred defaults before starting a session.

observations.behavior: Adds the Gear icon and the onOpenDefaultSettings prop to the component, and the callback implementation in TaskInput.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the UI implementation for the new configuration row. The callback connects the UI action to the settings navigation.
